messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Shopping and Retail" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Thank you for shopping with us.', 'THANK YOU FOR YOUR ORDER ORDER ID:MHDH2NVNZ6 RECEIPT DATE:20/10/2015 - ORDER TOTAL: $11.62', 'Your receipt #162013403684048', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', "I'm Betrugsfall known She Dan such wedder den PayPal- Noah den eBay Standard-Kuferschutz in Instruct Newman.", 'Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, richard@homepages.demon.co.uk', 'Your order has been successfully confirmed.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Your order has been successfully confirmed.', 'Thank you for your order.', 'We have recently failed to validate your Argos.co.UK information, we hold on record for your account, therefore we need to ask you to complete a brief validation process in order to verify billing details for your Argos.co.UK account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
